scope: Strict nested response contract for the private location-scoped true-cost accounting summary.

constraints.extra_fields: forbidden at every response object level
constraints.domain_enums: match hidden-cost, natural-capital, social-impact, and capital-flow schema checks
constraints.numeric_values: finite; monetary values retain signed semantics
constraints.request_path: top-level location identifier must match the requested path
constraints.validation: Explicitly validate the service projection before returning JSONResponse

error_contract.invalid_projection: sanitized 500 with Cache-Control: no-store and Vary: Cookie

limitations: This closes one response-contract slice only; live OIDC behavior, populated-data parity, and broader tenant isolation remain separate gates.
